_comment: What a blinded run receives as its input, per task: which of the subject's files the
harness fetches from the dataset (a glob relative to the subject's directory; it must
match exactly one file), the neutral name it is handed over under (relative to
input/<case>/), and the one sentence the prompt says about the scan. No subject,
session or dataset name reaches the agent: the neutral names carry none, the NIfTI
header's descriptive fields are blanked and the JSON sidecar is not shipped.

structural-brain-extraction.scan: a T1-weighted MRI of the head

structural-brain-extraction-pediatric.scan: a T1-weighted MRI of a child's head

structural-brain-extraction-motion.scan: a T1-weighted MRI of the head, acquired while the head moved

structural-brain-extraction-7t.scan: a 7T MP2RAGE T1-weighted (UNI) image of the head

structural-brain-extraction-7t-nodura.scan: a 7T MP2RAGE T1-weighted (UNI) image of the head
